subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept `openai/codex-action@52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` in workflows that provide an OpenAI API key after an explicit upstream contract audit?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary choice about executing a new third-party action revision with credentials; the available PR context and inaccessible local inspection environment cannot safely establish the action's exact runtime contract.

options.title: Audit then merge the Codex revision
options.body: Review the exact action revision and its credential handling, then accept this grouped update only if the new contract remains compatible with the repository workflows.

options.title: Split out the Codex action upgrade
options.body: Land the independently reviewable GitHub and Docker action updates separately and keep the credentialed Codex-action bump for focused security review.

options.title: Hold the dependency batch
options.body: Pause this grouped update until the workflow-action owners approve the external-action trust change.

recommendation.title: Audit then merge the Codex revision
recommendation.body: Review the exact action revision and its credential handling, then accept this grouped update only if the new contract remains compatible with the repository workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the upgraded external action contract that must be understood before credentialed repository workflows can adopt the revision.
